Job category:
Digital Marketing

Tehran

Employment type:
Full time

Minimum experience:
Three to six years

Gender:
Not important

Not important

Valid through:

Job description:
Artificial Intelligence and Content Production Expert --- Work location Tehran, Niavaran, Sahakernieh --- Advantages; Performance-based bonus; Continuous training; Career growth opportunities; Participation in creative and innovative projects --- About TADNA TADNA is developing a specialized Artificial Intelligence team for content production, media development, and digital project execution. If you are interested in the latest AI tools and use them to create professional content, this job is for you. --- Our job description is looking for someone who can produce textual, image, audio, and video content using AI tools and play an important role in the development of the group's media projects. --- Job Responsibilities: Producing textual content with AI; Producing advertising images; Producing short and long videos; Creating Instagram Reels; Producing scenarios; Designing professional prompts; Collaborating with the graphic team; Collaborating with the editing team; Collaborating with the digital marketing team; Researching and examining new AI tools --- Qualifications: Mastery of ChatGPT; Familiarity with Claude; Familiarity with Gemini; Familiarity with Midjourney; Familiarity with Runway; Familiarity with Kling; Familiarity with Veo; Familiarity with ElevenLabs; Familiarity with HeyGen; Familiarity with CapCut AI; Familiarity with Instagram content production --- Advantages: Familiarity with Photoshop; Familiarity with Premiere; Familiarity with After Effects; Familiarity with graphic design; Familiarity with video editing --- Personal Traits: Creative; Ideator; Technology enthusiast; Responsible; Organized; Team spirit --- Additional Information: Working days: Saturday to Thursday; Company location: Tehran, Niavaran, Sahakernieh

Company description:
Tadbir Negah Alvand is the first specialized media company for pharmaceuticals and treatment, focusing on the production and dissemination of specialized content in the fields of pharmaceuticals, health, news, and public information. Our goal is to inform compatriots about the correct use of medicines and vitamins, as well as awareness about preventing general diseases and the correct way to treat them. We seek to create a platform so that by clarifying and bringing the voices of people's concerns to the attention of officials, we can have a significant impact on improving our country's health system. Creating a comprehensive platform for fast, accurate, and reliable access to news and analyses in the health and pharmaceutical sectors is among the goals of our group. In addition to our work in medicine and treatment, we also have parallel and ongoing activities in automobiles, pain relief, transportation, and more. Address: Niavaran, Sahakernieh, Tangestan Fourth, Plot 4. Contact number: 21001008-021
